rows.text: secures **Rs 496 crore of new orders since its September 3 listing** — Rs 339 crore of conductor/cable manufacturing orders and a Rs 157 crore underground-cabling EPC order — taking its order book to Rs 3,215 crore

a credit-rating change: CRISIL **upgrades its long-term rating to A+/Stable from A/Stable**, short-term A1 reaffirmed, citing a Rs 3,090 crore order book and the Rs 500 crore raised in its 3 September IPO.
